content: Bahi Panayawi Ta Heliheliyamwi

Hauna puna ge lohalohaveyan ge ba apwaapwanawa i gan eliyamiu ami boda gamwanaa? Puna i ola hiwe: bugul hi gewi nuwamiu hot nuku ahe wami yaliyaya kaiwena, inoke amnan bolo o heliya iyoho hi logalogasisi tuwamiu gamwanaa.

Bugul etega nuwamiu, yaa nige bosowaimiu nuku ahe, inoke baena ku taulol. Bugul etega ku matamomoni-an, yaa nige bosowaimiu nuku ahe, inoke baena ku ba apwaapwanawa ge ku lohaveyan. Bugul bolo o nige ku aahe kaiwena nige ku aawanun Yehoba elana.
Ge sauga ku awanun Yehoba elana kaiweliya, nige i pepewa, kaiwena wami nuwatu i nak te ku awanun, nuwamiu bugul nuku ahe ge nuku patuwalali totomiu wami yaliyaya kaiwena.

Togolu gegetoga komiu! Age nige ku aatena te henala ebo panayawi buguliliyau i nunuwana-agil, iya i pihigelgel Yehoba elana? Ebo etega nuwana panayawi ni heliheliyamwi, iya i tabwa Yehoba ana topihigelgel.
Ku atena Buki Bwabwalena i ba bubun ya sauga i ba tage yayaluwa toto Yehoba i teli eliyala lomwaketa paganina i kalaopopwi.
Yaa Yehoba wana mulolu wala lomwaketa paganina i gasisi luwai. Heiya te kaiwena ge Buki Bwabwalena i ba:

content.text: Bolo tohanaha Yehoba nige i yaliyaya kaiweliya,
yaa bolo hi hanalau i muloluagil.

content: Inoke nuku minaa Yehoba wana logugui gabulanaa. Wami lohaveyan Seitani elana nuku talmilil gagasisi, inoke ni lou luwagimiu.
Nuku minek Yehoba labenaa, inoke iya ni minewa labemiwa. Togegi komiu, nimamiu bikena nuku ul yoho. Komiu bolo wami nuwatu i lalabui, nuwatu nanakina nuku ahek yoho atemiwa.
Atemiu ni lomwan, nuku nuwanak, nuku kahin. Wami nival nuku pil ni na nuwanak elana, ge wami yaliyaya nuku pil ni na nuwaleyan elana.
Nuku hanalau-agimiu Babala matanaa, inoke iya ni teli heyagimiu.
Awa Naknak Paganina Bana

Taliwau ge nuwau, bahi alomiyau nuku aawa naknakagil. Ebo gamagal etega talina ni awa nanakan ge ni ba panapanak-an, yaka Yehoba wana logugui i awa nanakan ge i ba panapanak-an, kaiwena logugui o i ba bahi ni giginol ola. Ebo Yehoba wana logugui u awa nanakan, he nige u hehenapu-an, yaa i ola wana logugui u pakot to.
Yehoba bosowaina gamagalau ni pwamwalil o ebo ni apanakil, inoke iya maisena te bosowaina logugui ni ginol ge bosowaina gamagalau ni pakotil. Inoke henala owa ge alom u awa naknakan?
Ba Hanahanaha Bana
Nuku laegan, komiu bolo ku ba, “Bwaligumwa o ebo bolu naha na ga panuwa etega, ge naha minaa ga o baliman maisena, inoke naha lopalipali ge wama mani ni bwata naha pwawa.”
Ku ba ola o, yaa nige ku aatena bwaligumwa hauna gun ni gan eliyamiu. Yawalimiu i ola gogau, sauga kekeisi ya ta kite, nige ana sauga i yayapu yaka i mowasi.
Binimala nuku ba ola hiwe, “Ebo Babala wana nuwatu i ola, he bwaligumwa naha molu nige naha yayaomal, inoke nuwatu toto ha nuwatuan naha ginol.”
Yaa age komiu ku hanahanaha ge totomiu ku ba heyagimiu. Ba hanahanaha ololana o i nak.
He i ola hiwe. Ebo gamagal etega i atena binimala pagan waiwaisana etega ni ginol, yaa nige i giginol, he iyaka i gegi to.
